description: One business capability: its definition, its sub-capabilities, the external authorities it cites, and WHICH catalog providers reach it with their ratings. Accepts a slug or a BC id (e.g. "payments-card-management" or "BC-1340"). Free. The per-tag edges WITH their evidence are get_capability_edges (Understanding). Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.
